title: Local identity-counit normalization for rank-zero bundle frames
statement: Let $N>0$, $A$ be a finite commutative ring killed by $N$, and $S$ a Noetherian scheme with $N$ invertible. Let $F$ be a locally free module of rank zero. Use the bundle and its identity-base Cartesian square of [def-pur-vector-trace-geometry], the source and local traces of [def-amb-vector-integration-charts], the identity compact-support comparison of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons], and the pullback identity comparison of [def-amb-affine-linear-trace-action]. Let $b:(1_S)^*R(1_S)_!A_S\xrightarrow{\sim}C_\pi$ have hom exactly the specified exchange component. For every normalized Tate transport $t$ and normalized projective-line data $D$, every open $V$ of $S$, and every rank-zero frame $e$ of $F$ over $V$, restriction of $b^{-1}$ followed by $(1_S)^*$ of the identity compact-support trace and then the inverse-image identity comparison, followed by the constant-unit pullback comparison over $V$, equals the prescribed local map $a_{V,e}$ of vectorIntegrationLocalTrace. This is an equation of explicit local derived maps and does not refer to the globally glued integration.

proof.text: A general cancellation calculation: if an invertible square a:LP→PR respects the two composition maps and L,R have the given identity comparisons, then P(e_L)=a e_R. Apply naturality of a to e_L, cancel a at LK, and use faithfulness of R, which is isomorphic to the identity. This calculation is proved privately without geometric hypotheses.

proof.text: Apply the preceding calculation to the bounded-below inclusion, compact support along the identity, and rightDerivedLowerShriekPlusCompatibility. unboundedEtaleCompactSupport_composition_plus and the left unit laws supply the composition equation. Expanding the zero case of affineLinearCompactComparison and cancelling its inclusion comparison proves that its inverse is exactly unboundedEtaleLowerShriekId at the constant unit.

proof.text: Apply the same calculation to exact pullback along V.ι and compact support along identity maps. The compact-support exchange is invertible by unboundedEtaleCompactSupport_baseChange, and its vertical composition equation is unboundedEtaleCompactSupport_baseChange_composition. Its unit laws therefore identify the identity-projection exchange with the two identity compact-support comparisons. Transport through leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory using naturality to obtain the left-derived equation.

proof.text: Apply the rank-zero coefficient normalization lemma: the pullback compositor for chart≫π=V.ι followed by vectorIntegrationChartCoefficient is ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback. This is a strictly smaller coefficient calculation, independent of compact-support exchange, the bounded/unbounded comparison, and the affine counit.

proof.text: Precompose the target equation by V.ι pullback of b.hom, which is invertible. Use hb and affineLinearExchange_paste for zero_isPullback followed by the chart square, with the explicit composites identified by the chart equation. Combine the compact-support images of the chart compositor and coefficient using Step 4. The zero affine counit is literally the identity adjunction counit; Step 2 replaces the zero compact comparison. Naturality of the compact-support identity comparison and Step 3 give pullback of the identity trace. Finally the right pullback unit equation and naturality of affineLinearPullbackId give exactly the requested composite. No rank positivity, nonempty-open, or nonzero-ring assumption is used.

theorem vectorIntegration_rankZero_localIdentity (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank 0]
    (b : (ordinaryFinitePullback A (𝟙 S)).obj
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (𝟙 S)).obj
          (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S)) ≅ vectorIntegrationSource A N hA S 0 F)
    (hb : b.hom = (rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A
      (VectorTraceGeometry.zero_isPullback S F)).app (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S))
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t T hT)
    (V : S.Opens) (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S 0 F V) :
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A V.ι).map
        (b.inv ≫ (ordinaryFinitePullback A (𝟙 S)).map
          ((unboundedEtaleLowerShriekId A S).hom.app (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S)) ≫
            (affineLinearPullbackId A S).hom.app (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S)) ≫
      (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A V.ι).hom =
    vectorIntegrationLocalTrace N hN A hA t D S hS 0 F V e
